upstream.description: UniFace: A Unified Face Analysis Library for Python | Detection, alignment, landmarks, face-mesh, recognition, parsing, gaze, attributes and anti-spoofing under one API.

classification.analysis: UniFace is a Python computer-vision library that unifies fifteen face-analysis tasks — detection, recognition/verification, tracking, landmarks, face mesh, parsing/segmentation, portrait matting, gaze/head-pose estimation, demographics, emotion, face states, quality assessment, anti-spoofing, and anonymization — behind one `FaceAnalyzer` API, backed by ONNX Runtime models (RetinaFace, ArcFace, BiSeNet, MODNet, etc.) that run on CPU, Apple Silicon, or CUDA. It ships a FAISS-backed embedding store and downloads SHA-256-verified weights on first use. This is a classical deep-learning face-analysis toolkit rather than an LLM or generative-media tool, so it doesn't fit the listed domains cleanly; it's filed under media-generation as the closest match.

use_cases.title: Detect and recognize faces in an image with one unified API
Anonymize faces in a dataset before publishing images
Check for spoofed or replayed faces in a liveness check
Estimate age, emotion, or gaze direction from a photo
